en: Living today well is the best preparation for tomorrow.
zh: 把今天过好，就是对未来最好的准备。

en: Slow is fine, as long as you're headed the right way.
zh: 慢一点没关系，方向对了就好。

en: You don't need to do everything at once. One thing well is enough.
zh: 你不需要一次做好所有事，一次做好一件事就够了。

en: Small steps every day are never wasted.
zh: 日拱一卒，功不唐捐。

en: Start first, perfect later.
zh: 先开始，再完美。

en: Break big things down; do small things extremely well.
zh: 把复杂的事拆小，把小事做到极致。

en: Rest isn't laziness — it's how you go further.
zh: 休息不是偷懒，是为了走更远的路。

en: Today's effort becomes tomorrow's confidence.
zh: 今天的汗水，是明天的底气。

en: Don't compare with others. Compare with yesterday's you.
zh: 别和别人比，和昨天的自己比。

en: Luck hides inside action.
zh: 好运藏在行动里。

en: Replace 'someday' with 'five minutes, right now'.
zh: 把“等有空再说”换成“现在就做五分钟”。

en: Focus is the last superpower of adulthood.
zh: 专注，是成年人最后的超能力。

en: Write it down, and it's half done.
zh: 写下来，事情就完成了一半。

en: Allow yourself to go slow, just don't stop.
zh: 允许自己慢慢来，但别停下来。

en: Your environment shapes you — shape it first.
zh: 环境会塑造你，先塑造你的环境。

en: Less screen, more horizon.
zh: 少看手机，多看远方。

en: Think big things small, and small things big.
zh: 把大事想小，把小事想大。

en: Done beats perfect.
zh: 完成比完美更重要。

en: 1% better every day — you won't recognize yourself in a year.
zh: 每天进步 1%，一年后你会认不出自己。

en: Emotions are messengers, not masters.
zh: 情绪是信使，不是主人。

en: Take care of yourself first; then you'll have strength for the world.
zh: 先照顾好自己，才有力气照顾世界。

en: Passion outlasts the longest years.
zh: 热爱可抵岁月漫长。

en: The best time to plant a tree was ten years ago. The second best is now.
zh: 种一棵树最好的时间是十年前，其次是现在。

en: Stay curious, stay kind, keep moving.
zh: 保持好奇，保持温柔，保持前进。

en: You can't calm the storm, but you can stop sailing into it.
zh: 你平息不了风暴，但可以选择不驶入风暴。

en: Boring consistency beats exciting intensity.
zh: 乏味的坚持，胜过激情的三分钟。

en: Your attention is your life — spend it where it matters.
zh: 注意力在哪里，人生就在哪里。
